from fractions import Fraction as F
hole=(F(35,100),F(1,10))
holes={hole}
holes|={(x,1-y) for x,y in holes}   # unfold horizontal fold
holes|={(1-x,y) for x,y in holes}   # unfold vertical fold
xs=sorted({x for x,y in holes})
paired_near_centre = all(abs(x-F(1,2))<F(1,4) for x in xs)
opts={'A':(True,'diamond'),'B':(True,'square'),'C':(False,'two triangles'),'D':(False,'diamond')}
# corner of the folded quarter at the paper centre is cut by a diagonal -> diamond at centre
sig=(paired_near_centre,'diamond')
assert opts['A']==sig
for k in 'BCD': assert opts[k]!=sig
